briefdescription.para: Wave D — Execution Engine Dedicated Benchmark Gates.

detaileddescription.para: Benchmark IDs: EX-BM-01 — Enqueue p95 latency (bounded queue hot path) EX-BM-02 — Dequeue p95 latency (bounded queue hot path) EX-BM-03 — Work-steal throughput (items stolen per second) EX-BM-04 — Concurrent dispatch throughput (N producers → 1 queue)

entry.para: Dispatch throughput ≥ 500 k items/s at 8 threads

simplesect.para: No external dependencies beyond standard library + GoogleBenchmark.
